_doc: The native SDK versions this bridge is built and published against — the ONE place
they are written, read by android/build.gradle (JsonSlurper) and by
ZeotapReactNative.podspec so a bump cannot be applied to one platform only.
VERSION_NAME and sdk/ios/VERSION, so the monorepo cannot drift from the bridge; the
release job additionally checks the pinned artifacts are actually resolvable before
publishing (a version that exists here but not on Maven Central / CocoaPods trunk
installs as a broken package for every consumer).

includeBuild + dependencySubstitution, and `pod 'ZeotapSDK', :path =>` for iOS), so a
